topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I been thinkin' 'bout what happened, and my mind's been turnin' like a millwheel. It weren’t right what I did, takin' that young artist’s piece and markin' it on my skin. Thought it was just somethin’ pretty, somethin’ to spruce up this old hide, but now I see it’s more than that. It’s his craft, his heart poured out. I should’ve asked, should’ve known better. Now, there’s a cloud hangin' over me, and I reckon I gotta make it right. Maybe if I talk to him, explain my folly, he’ll understand. I just hope the saints have mercy on my soul and he does too.
